  type Student
  type Tutor

  // Define assignment as a map from students to tutors
  type Assignment = map<Student, Tutor>
  
  // Function to check if an assignment is valid
  predicate ValidAssignment(a: Assignment) {
    forall s :: s in a.Keys ==> Qualified(a[s], s)

  predicate CompleteAssignment(a: Assignment, students: set<Student>) {
    students == a.Keys
